BOŞLUK BEYANI: arandı, bulunamadı: Palenque’nin 799 sonrası siyasî sahibi. UNESCO no. 411 «Pre-Hispanic City and National Park of Palenque» (açıldı 22.10.2026): «Once the ancient city of Palenque was abandoned around the 9th century, the thick jungle surrounding it covered its temples and palaces»;
